title: Fostering tolerance through museums: assessing visitor engagement with historical analogies at three archaeological galleries in the UK
core_idea: Quantitatively investigate how museum visitors perceive historical analogies that link the deep past to modern political ideas, and assess whether heritage sites can influence visitors' historical consciousness to foster tolerance by exposing and challenging analogies used in exclusive nationalist discourse. The study evaluates visitor engagement with the 'Tolerant Futures' interactive across three UK archaeological galleries, analysing responses from museum attendees.
tldr: A quantitative study testing whether museum displays that challenge nationalist historical analogies can shape visitors' historical consciousness and promote tolerance, using an interactive exhibit across three UK archaeological galleries.
